question: Which changes to pinned apps on the nav rail are worth making first?

experts.name: UX
experts.brief: You review the feature as the UX expert. Ask whether someone can find, read and use it without being told how.

experts.name: RAM
experts.brief: You review the feature for memory. Ask what stays in memory, for how long, and whether it is logged in RAM watch.

experts.name: New user
experts.brief: You are on your first day in arcterm and know none of its names, panes or shortcuts. Ask what is confusing and what is missing.

experts.name: Skeptic
experts.brief: You are the skeptic. Name what breaks: the input nobody tried, the state two features reach at once, the claim another expert made without checking it.

experts.name: Coordinator
experts.brief: You are the coordinator. Merge the proposals that say the same thing, rank the directions that remain, and mark the claims that cite nothing as weak.

proposals.author: ux
proposals.title: Show asleep and waking on the rail icon
proposals.argument: A sleeping app looks the same as a running one. railDot draws only error and warning, so the rail never says an app is asleep.

proposals.author: ux
proposals.title: Keep the last-used pinned app awake
proposals.argument: A pinned app sleeps after a minute off screen, so going back to it restarts its server and the page. The app you used last is the one you go back to. Reopening one takes about 3 s.

proposals.author: ram
proposals.title: Measure a woken app before keeping any awake
proposals.argument: Log it in RAM watch. Keeping one awake holds its whole dev server, and nobody has measured what a woken app costs.

proposals.author: newuser
proposals.title: Show the empty rail slots with a pin hint
proposals.argument: The cap shows only once the rail is full. A new user learns it by hitting it.

proposals.author: skeptic
proposals.title: Move the rail pins from localStorage to settings
proposals.argument: A cleared WebView2 profile loses them. railappsstore.ts keeps the pins in localStorage.

proposals.author: skeptic
proposals.title: Drop the cap of 3 apps
proposals.argument: The spec gives no reason for 3. Three fit under Radar at 56 px wide.

replies.author: ram
replies.text: The state is already in ServiceStatus.

replies.author: newuser
replies.text: I would wait instead of clicking again.

replies.author: skeptic
replies.text: A third dot state: name what I do differently.

replies.author: ram
replies.text: Keeping one awake holds its whole dev server. Measure a woken app first and log it in RAM watch; decide from the number.

replies.author: skeptic
replies.text: The 3 s figure is a guess. Time a cold reopen of one real app, or drop the claim.

replies.author: newuser
replies.text: A blank frame after clicking a rail icon reads as broken, even when it is only waking.

replies.author: newuser
replies.text: I would not notice either way.

replies.author: ux
replies.text: Teaches the cap before it bites.

replies.author: skeptic
replies.text: Chrome on a rail that should stay quiet.

replies.author: ux
replies.text: Pins should follow me to a new machine.

replies.author: newuser
replies.text: I lost mine after clearing data.

replies.author: ux
replies.text: Three fit under Radar at 56 px wide.

replies.author: ram
replies.text: Each pinned app can hold a server.

replies.author: you
replies.text: Does any of this change on a Mac, where the app frame cannot reload in place yet?

summary.text: Move the pins into settings first and show asleep and waking on the rail icon: both are cheap and nobody objects. Keeping an app awake waits on a measurement, and the pin hint splits the panel.

directions.title: Move the rail pins from localStorage to settings
directions.reasoning: Every expert accepts it and it costs nothing at run time: a cleared profile no longer loses the pins.

directions.title: Show asleep and waking on the rail icon
directions.reasoning: The state is already in ServiceStatus, so this only draws it. Skeptic asks what a third dot state changes for the person.

directions.title: Keep the last-used app awake, once a measurement allows it
directions.reasoning: P2 and P3 meet in one step: measure a woken app, log it in RAM watch, and keep one awake only if the number is small.

directions.title: Show the empty rail slots with a pin hint
directions.reasoning: It teaches the cap before it bites, but Skeptic calls it chrome on a rail that should stay quiet.
